description: Update a lifecycle strategy event by ID. Editing re-confirms the cost (cost_reviewed_on is server-set). Set is_active false to disable an event without deleting it - projections recompute immediately. Requires infrastructure_lifecycle_events:write scope.

cost_method.description: Costing: per unit (uses the feature's measured quantity and unit) or a fixed amount (default per_unit)

cost_source.description: Provenance of the cost ("Engineering 2026", a tender reference)

event_class.description: Event type - preventative maintenance or rehabilitation

impact_add_years.description: Years added (required when impact_method is add_years)

impact_method.description: Effect: add years of life, or reset condition to a value

impact_reset_to.description: Condition after the event (required when impact_method is reset_condition)

max_applications.description: How many times the event may fire over a feature's life (default 1)

min_years_between.description: Minimum years between firings of a recurring event (default 1)

trigger_condition_max.description: Upper bound of the trigger window - the event fires when projected condition falls to this

trigger_condition_min.description: Lower bound of the trigger window (default 0); a feature already below it has missed the event

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit (current dollars, never indexed)

work_generation.description: What a due application of this event becomes when created from the interventions list: none (plan only, default), work_order, or project. Nothing is created on a schedule.

work_generation_category_id.description: Work category for generated work orders - resolve with list_work_categories. Ignored unless work_generation is work_order.

work_generation_priority.description: Priority for generated work orders. Ignored unless work_generation is work_order.

name: update_infrastructure_lifecycle_event
title: Update infrastructure lifecycle event
